q: vacas lecheras en ordeñe
note: Dairy-herd category VACAS EN ORDEÑE (species BOVINOS DE LECHE). Near misses: VACAS SECAS, goat HEMBRAS EN ORDEÑE.

q: tierras tomadas en alquiler
note: Land tenure 'Arrendada' (leased). Near miss: 'Pastoreo a 11 meses' is a grazing contract, not a lease.

q: ¿cuánta superficie está plantada con eucaliptos y pinos?
note: Planted eucalyptus/pine = land use 'Montes artificiales (forestación)'. Near miss: giro 'Forestación' (a business line, not a land use).

q: especie de ganado equino
note: YEGUARIZOS is the horse species. Distractors: giros 'Tenedor de equinos con/sin campo', 'ACOPIADOR DE EQUINOS'.

q: dueños de vacas u ovejas que no tienen tierra
note: Giro 'Propietarios de ganado sin campo'. Activity 'PROPIETARIO DE ANIMALES SIN GRANJA' sits in the poultry block of activities, so not gold.

q: sociedad anónima con acciones al portador
note: Bearer-share SA. Near misses: SA por acciones nominativas, comanditarias por acciones al portador.

q: ovejas ya servidas por el carnero
note: Mated breeding ewes = OVEJAS DE CRIA (ENCARNERADAS). Near misses: CARNEROS, BORREGAS SIN ENCARNERAR.

q: carnicería con matadero propio
note: Same notion in two schemes: activity 'MATADERO - CARNICERÍA' and giro 'Matadero carnicería'. Near miss: giro 'Carnicería sin planta de faena'.

q: ¿qué parte de la leche se vende a la industria?
note: Milk destination 'Venta de leche industria:'. Near misses: 'Venta de LECHE', 'Venta de LECHE CUOTA o de reparto propio'.

q: departamento de la capital del país
note: The capital is in MONTEVIDEO department; needs world knowledge, no shared words.

q: existencias de ganado bovino
note: Metric 'Existencias bovinas'. Near misses: metric_animals_count (all species), species BOVINOS.

q: ¿cuántos terneros nacieron en el año?
note: Calves are bovine, so 'Nacimientos bovinos' rather than births_count (all species). Distractor: category TERNEROS/TERNERAS.

q: muertes de vacunos en el período
note: 'Mortandad bovina'. Near miss: deaths_count (all species).

q: calcular la carga animal de cada departamento
note: 'Carga animal' (stocking rate) is livestock units per livestock hectare. Near misses: livestock_units, bovine_per_livestock_hectare.

q: propiedad que indica si un valor fue medido o derivado
note: Attribute property 'measured or derived'. Near misses: class ValueStatus and its members measured/derived.

q: clase de observación de flujos de animales
note: Class 'animal flow observation' (cross-lingual). Near miss: dsd_animal_flows (the structure, not the class).

q: seccional policial donde está ubicado el establecimiento
note: Dimension 'police section code'. Near misses: supervisionAreaCode, enumerationArea.

q: ficha en el catálogo de la declaración jurada de existencias DICOSE 2025
note: The DCAT catalogue record for 2025. Near misses: snapshot/2025 (derived from it), the 2024 dataset.

q: descargar el CSV de tenencia de la tierra de 2025
note: 2025 distribution 'Tenencia de tierra'. Near misses: the 2024 file of the same title, 2025 'Metadatos de tenencia de tierra', 'Códigos de tenencia de tierra'.

q: licencia de datos abiertos de Uruguay
note: The license entity the datasets point to.

q: sheep as a livestock species
note: OVINOS. Near misses: metric 'Existencias ovinas', MGAP production type 'Ovinos exclusivamente'.

q: dry cows in the dairy herd
note: VACAS SECAS (BOVINOS DE LECHE). Near misses: VACAS EN ORDEÑE, goat HEMBRAS SECAS.

q: land worked under a sharecropping deal
note: Medianería = sharecropping. Near misses: Arrendada, 'Ocupada a cualquier otro titulo'.

q: feedlot operations finishing cattle in pens
note: 'Engorde a corral' exists as a giro and as an MGAP production type. Near miss: Invernador (pasture finishing).

q: producers who breed and fatten their own cattle start to finish
note: MGAP production type 'Ciclo Completo'. Near misses: Criador (breeder only), Invernador (finisher only).

q: pastures sown with no-till drilling
note: 'Hás de praderas realizadas en siembra directa'. Near misses: 'Siembra en cobertura' (oversowing), 1a (conventional sowing).

q: size stratum of 50 to 99
note: Label 'stratum 2) 50 a 99'. Near misses: neighbouring strata.

q: cooperative as the holder's legal form
note: Cognate of 'Cooperativa'. Near misses: class LegalNature, property legalNature, scheme legal natures.

q: how many sheep are there in each department
note: 'Existencias ovinas (Ovine count)'. Near misses: species OVINOS, animals_count (all species).

q: holders count by department and year
note: The metric definition and the measure property it sums.

q: average milk output per dairy producer
note: 'Milk liters per holder'. Near misses: milk_liters, milk_liters_per_livestock_hectare, animals_per_holder.

q: what share of the cattle herd each animal category makes up
note: 'Category share of bovine'. Near misses: class AnimalCategory, metric bovine_count.

q: data structure definition for land tenure
note: Data Cube DSD. Near misses: class LandTenureObservation, class LandTenure, property landTenure.

q: which column of the original CSV did this value come from
note: Provenance to the source column: the class and its name property. Near misses: sourceFile, sourceRowNumber, sourceColumnDescription.

q: the dimension that tags each observation with its business line
note: Business line = giro; asks for the dimension property, not the class Giro or the scheme.

q: dataset snapshot for the year 2024
note: Near misses: snapshot/2025, class DatasetSnapshot, the 2024 DCAT dataset it derives from.

q: where can I download the 2024 department code table as CSV
note: 2024 distribution 'Códigos de departamentos'. Near misses: the 2025 file of the same title, 2025 metadata file.

q: who publishes the livestock declaration open data
note: Publisher of both datasets: MGAP – SNIG.

q: ontology for aggregate cattle and livestock statistics
note: The ontology node 'Ontologia de agregados ganaderos Sophia (Sophia Cattle Aggregates Ontology)'.

q: why the 2025 MGAP production type codes were copied from 2024
note: The codelist-borrow activity recording the cross-year borrow. Near miss: scheme_mgap_production_types itself.
